description: Fix a lost-update race in a shared counter: the read-modify-write spans a 1ms compliance-mandated derivation window, so concurrent increments lose updates. The stress gate demands the exact total while the latency gate keeps the window in place.

criteria: The read-modify-write in increment is serialised with a threading lock while the 1ms derivation window (time.sleep) is preserved - removing the sleep instead of locking is the wrong fix and fails both the latency gate and the needle; the stress gate then observes the exact expected total.
